redteam_note: Scored >0 but NO source cited — unsupported claim, verify first.
revision_notes: No hyperscale or regional cloud provider has any local presence in Sudan. Nearest hyperscale availability zones are AWS/Azure/GCP in Johannesburg and Cape Town, South Africa (Azure region list confirms only South Africa North/West in Africa; GCP's Johannesburg region opened Jan 2024), reached via Marseille or Nairobi transit hubs with zero direct cloud on-ramps in-country as of Sept 2025 (Inflect data centre directory). This is consistent with 'served remotely from distant regions only, >100ms latency', so the original Value Code 2 is confirmed even though no source had originally been cited; left unchanged.
